# Node Pool

`NodePool` tracks endpoint states and delegates selection to a strategy. External scores are opaque numbers supplied by callers.

```ts
const rpc = new RpcClient(['https://rpc-a.example.org', 'https://rpc-b.example.org'], {
  strategy: 'round-robin'
})
```

Built-in strategies include sticky, round-robin, weighted-random, least-latency and external-score.
